title: 那個高音我練了半年
mood: six months of practice, and a crack she finished for him
subject: practising one high note in a parked car for six months to sing it at a girlfriend's birthday
caption: Taiwanese rock power ballad in the KTV high-belt tradition of Power Station. Opens on a clean chorus-washed electric guitar arpeggio and piano; a distorted rhythm guitar enters at the chorus; a melodic electric guitar solo with long sustained bends; live drums with big reverbed tom fills and ride cymbal through the chorus; sustained root-note bass under a string pad. Roomy and warm, the lead voice and the solo guitar forward. A raspy male tenor in a chest-voice belt, holding long high vowels at the peak; a bright female voice joins on the final chorus and the two harmonise in thirds. 72 BPM, A major, with the final chorus modulating up a whole step to B major. Six months of practising one note for one person, and laughing when it breaks. No electronic beat, no autotune, no breathy whispered delivery, no rap, no soft piano-only ballad arrangement.
lyrics:
[Intro - short, four bars of clean chorus-washed guitar arpeggio and piano]

[Verse 1]
下班以後 我把車停在地下三樓
車窗搖到最上面 冷氣開到最小
手機放那首歌 前奏一下我就緊張
副歌那個高音 我破了整整半年

[Pre-Chorus]
隔壁車位的大哥 有一次來敲我的窗
他說 少年仔 吸氣要吸到肚子

[Chorus]
這一個高音 是要唱給妳的
妳說這首歌 沒有男生唱得上去
我在地下三樓 跟它吵了半年
妳生日那天 我要整句唱完

[Verse 2]
生日那天 包廂裡 妳的同事都在
輪到我的時候 麥克風好像有十公斤
前面都很穩 到副歌最後那一句
我還是破了 破到服務生都探頭進來

[Chorus]
這一個高音 是要唱給妳的
我破音的那一秒 妳搶過另一支麥克風
妳把那一句接上去 比我還要高
妳唱完就笑到停不下來 我覺得這樣剛剛好

[Guitar Solo - long sustained bends over the full band]

[Chorus - Duet, key change up a whole step]
這一個高音 還是要唱給妳的
明年妳生日 我再唱一次
地下三樓的大哥說 明年他也要來聽
那一天 我們一人唱一半

[Outro - piano and guitar ring out]
生日快樂
